rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Hong Kong term for the knitted upper-body garment.

example.english: It's cold, so I put on a thick jersey.
example.traditional: 天氣凍，我着咗件厚冷衫。
example.jyutping: tin1 hei3 dung3 ngo5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 hau5 laang1 saam1

rows.note: Use this for a shirt worn as part of a sports team’s uniform, especially a football shirt.

example.english: I bought a new jersey and will wear it to watch the match tonight.
example.traditional: 我買咗件新波衫，今晚睇波着。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gin6 san1 bo1 saam1 gam1 maan5 tai2 bo1 zoek6
